question: How much of the UK is woodland?
sparql_query: SELECT (( SUM(strdf:area(?fWKT)) / ?ukArea ) AS ?woodland) WHERE { yago:United_Kingdom geo:hasGeometry ?ukGeo . ?ukGeo geo:asWKT ?ukWKT BIND(strdf:area(?ukWKT) AS ?ukArea) ?forest rdf:type y2geoo:OSM_forest ; geo:hasGeometry ?fGeo . ?fGeo geo:asWKT ?fWKT FILTER geof:sfWithin(?fWKT, ?ukWKT) } GROUP BY ?forest ?ukArea
engine_query:
SET statement_timeout = '60s';
SELECT * FROM ag_catalog.cypher('yago2geo_uk_subset', $$
MATCH (united_kingdom)
WHERE (united_kingdom.uri = 'http://yago-knowledge.org/resource/United_Kingdom' OR united_kingdom.yago_uri = 'http://yago-knowledge.org/resource/United_Kingdom')
WITH united_kingdom
MATCH (forest:OSM_forest)

$$) AS (woodland agtype);
